description: Returns the @gemmein/sdk API reference (REFERENCE.md): every method, exact signature, return shape, and the stable error-code table. Useful while writing code against the SDK. With `topic` (a module or method: "g.collection", "checkout") it returns only the matching sections — the packaged text plus each section's direct link, https://docs.gemmein.com/reference.md#<section>. `guide` covers how the model works and whether an app fits; `search_docs` finds one fact in either document.

topic.description: optional: a module or method — returns only its sections instead of the whole reference

name: reference
title: Reference
